text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo! Happy birthday. Hey, let's hit up that 
cake shop on the outer perimeter course!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Right now? ...No, but... I have vocal 
training scheduled after this today.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the thought, but doing it 
right now is a bit—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...What, we've still got plenty of time! 
If we make a quick dash, we'll make it no 
problem! I'll even show you a nice 
shortcut."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, in order to approach vocal 
training with my usual composure...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still as serious as ever, huh... Though, 
are you sure that's okay? Sticking to 
'business as usual'?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's your birthday, ain't it? If there's 
something you wanna change up, isn't this 
your chance to give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Right――... Yes, you're right. Understood. 
I'll give it a shot... going for a run."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's what I'm talkin' about! My 
treat, anything you want. What're you 
craving?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"No, please don't worry about me—actually, 
no... In that case, could I have the 
muscat tart, please?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's all you need for a birthday!
